landing.headline: AI-Powered Protection Against Job & Internship Scams
landing.subhead: Empowering South Asian students and job seekers with instant, explainable 5-Agent AI scam verification for job offers, emails, WhatsApp messages, and recruiter URLs.
landing.feature_1_desc: Multi-stage automated intelligence analyzing intake text, OCR image screenshots, WHOIS domain age, and linguistic risk factors.
landing.feature_2_desc: Native analysis and explainable results in English, Sinhala (සිංහල), Tamil (தமிழ்), Hindi (हिंदी), and Bengali (বাংলা).
landing.feature_3_desc: Instant background validation against Google Safe Browsing and corporate WHOIS registries.
landing.feature_4_desc: Actionable, plain-language guidance to protect your identity, finances, and career.
